benefits.name: Dining Statement Credit
benefits.description: Up to $300 in statement credits per year (up to $25 per month) for eligible purchases at restaurants worldwide.
benefits.terms: Restaurants worldwide. Unused monthly credit does not roll over.

benefits.name: Marriott Bonvoy Property Credit
benefits.description: Up to $100 property credit for eligible on-property purchases (dining, spa, recreational activities) at The Ritz-Carlton or St. Regis with a 2-night minimum stay booked at the designated Member rate.
benefits.terms: Requires booking a 2-night minimum stay through Marriott Bonvoy at the "$100 Property Credit, Luxury Credit Card Rate." Excludes room cost, taxes, gratuities, and property fees. Applied on property, not as an Amex statement credit.

benefits.name: TSA PreCheck / Global Entry Credit
benefits.description: Statement credit for a TSA PreCheck or Global Entry application fee.

benefits.name: Complimentary Marriott Bonvoy Platinum Elite Status
benefits.description: Automatic Marriott Bonvoy Platinum Elite status, including 4pm late checkout when available, a 50% points bonus, complimentary room upgrades, and lounge access at some hotels.

benefits.name: 25 Elite Night Credits
benefits.description: 25 Elite Night Credits toward the next level of Marriott Bonvoy Elite status, credited each calendar year.

benefits.name: Annual Free Night Award
benefits.description: Annual Free Night Award certificate worth up to 85,000 Marriott Bonvoy points, renewed each card anniversary year. Up to 15,000 additional points can be added toward a higher-value property.
benefits.terms: Can be topped up with up to 15,000 personal points for properties costing up to 100,000 points total.

benefits.name: Priority Pass Select Membership
benefits.description: Complimentary Priority Pass Select membership providing airport lounge access.

loungeAccessDetail.guestPolicy: Cardholder plus 2 guests included; $35 per additional guest, per visit. Lounge access only — restaurant/experience credits not included.

benefits.name: Trip Delay Insurance
benefits.description: Reimbursement for reasonable expenses when a trip is delayed.

benefits.name: Trip Cancellation & Interruption Insurance
benefits.description: Reimbursement for prepaid, non-refundable travel expenses when a covered trip is cancelled or cut short.

benefits.name: Baggage Insurance Plan
benefits.description: Coverage for lost, damaged, or stolen checked and carry-on luggage while traveling.

benefits.name: Car Rental Loss and Damage Insurance
benefits.description: Coverage for damage or theft of most rental cars.

earningRates.terms: Eligible purchases at hotels participating in Marriott Bonvoy.
